answer: Forging 260 of these means building 260 separate tachograph records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The defence rests on hGV licence tenure with tachograph record history: tachographs filed under one licence for years. The nebula check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The ripple record is public, the forge cost is per identity, and 260 aliases cost 260 times one honest seat.
